name: 音素相関解析
mechanism:
This method analyzes phoneme-visual correlation for deepfake detection:

1. **音声音素抽出**: The audio track is processed to extract a phoneme sequence with precise temporal alignment. Each phoneme is identified with its onset-offset timestamps and confidence score using speech recognition.

2. **視覚的音素(Viseme)検出**: The corresponding visual phoneme (viseme) sequence is extracted from lip/jaw motion analysis. Key visemes include: bilabial closure (/m/, /p/, /b/), labiodental (/f/, /v/), dental (/θ/, /ð/), and open vowels (/a/, /o/).

3. **音素-Viseme時間的相関**: The temporal alignment between audio phonemes and visual visemes is measured. In authentic speech, audio leads visual by ~50ms (auditory-visual speech lag). The method computes cross-correlation to check this temporal relationship. Deepfakes may show incorrect timing between audio and visual speech.

4. **ArticulationCompleteness**: Certain phonemes require specific visual articulations that are physiologically mandatory — /m/ requires complete lip closure, /f/ requires lip-teeth contact. The method checks whether mandatory articulations are achieved. Deepfake lip generators may fail to produce complete target articulations.

5. **Co-Articulationパターン検証**: In natural speech, phoneme production is influenced by surrounding phonemes (anticipatory and carry-over coarticulation). The method checks for natural coarticulation effects in the visual speech signal. AI-generated lip movements often lack proper coarticulation, producing discrete viseme transitions.
parameters:
分析タイプ: sensor
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through phoneme correlation analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
